verdict.rationale: Zamzar is a cloud file-conversion service, so background automations such as scheduled or watch-folder conversions are a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows only an API for submitting one-off conversion jobs (a developer building block) and an 'Email when done?' notification option. Neither is a product-native, recurring, autonomous automation feature, so no credit is given.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
